title: Qaafela Sheh ka Salaami Lab-e-Darya Uthraa
body:
Qaafela sheh ka salaami lab-e-darya uthraa
Par muqaddar mai na ek paani ka qathra uthraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala ka jo kisi shaher mai naqsha uthraa
Mujrayee boli zameen arsh-e-moalla uthraa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Imtihaan ki jo taraazu mai qazaaney tholaa
Hur wafaadari-e-shabbir mai poora uthraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajda-e-haq sey nabi ney na utthaaya sar ko
Pushth-e-aqdas sey na jab takh ke nawaasa uthraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Fouj manzil pay utarthi toh Sakina kehthi
Saahibo dekho kidhar hai mera baba uthraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaya jab takh na madiney mai sar-e-ibney ziyaad
Sogh naamoos-e-nabi mai na kisi ka uthraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sogh Zainab ney bhi hazrath ka uthaara yaaro
Par na jannath mai siyaa jaama-e-zehra uthraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Bano kehthi thi ke kisi roz pehnaaya afsous
Khoon mai bharkay meray bachchey ka kurta uthraa
